releases.title: Discord RPC Reliability, Gacha Levels & Region Fixes, CS2/Fortnite Priority
highlights: Fixed Discord RPC stopping for a split Second and getting Taken over by other Apps/Games
Fixed Gacha game icons, accurate game-specific Server Region, and live Gacha Level display (AR, TL, IK Lv., UL, etc.) while playing.
Fixed Roblox Home icon loading.
Fixed Lang!ley always trying to Update even it was on the Latest Version.
Performance Improvements.
Spotify/Music Controller got fixed and works flawless now.
Fixed a Bug where Lang!ley still showed Minimized Games and Launchers.
Fixed Lang!ley shooting around with Priority Locks more often that Lang!ley needed to.

releases.title: Major and Minor Bug Fixes
highlights: Fixed Major and Small Bugs.

releases.title: Gacha Games Support and Major Bug Fixes
highlights: Added the new Lang!ley Slogan: Lang!ley - Play Everythig. Show Everything.
Added full Epic Games Store & Launcher support.
Added all HoYoPlay, and some other Gacha Games.
Lang!ley now gets prioritized above all other Discord RPCs.
Game Logos got fixed.
Added Custom External Games and Apps to Lang!ley. So you can also show (currently) unsupported Games (or even Apps) in your Discord RPC.
Fixed Xbox Version of Fortnite conflicting with the Fortnite RPC and not showing up.
Fixed that Launchers in tray (like Roblox, Lunar Client etc. get shown
Fixed a Bug that you could only Scroll when hovering on the Scrollbar.

releases.title: Battle.net and Minecraft Support
highlights: Added Blizzard Battle.net Support.
Added Minecraft (Vanilla and Client) Support.
Added a feature that Lang!ley shows up on top of Medal.tv.
Fixed some minor Bugs.

releases.title: Riot Games, EA, Ubisoft, and GOG Galaxy Support
highlights: Added native detectors Riot Games, EA App, Ubisoft Connect, and GOG Galaxy Support.
Added GAME HUB.
Added Platform Friend Lists.

releases.title: XBOX and Roblox Support
highlights: Added Xbox Support.
Added Roblox Support.
Minor Bug fixes.

releases.title: Steam Support and Music Controller
highlights: Added Steam Support.
Added CS2 and DOTA 2 live Stats.
Added Music Controller.

releases.title: Initial Release — Fortnite Rich Presence
highlights: Added Fortnite Discord RPC with Live Stats.
Added Live equipped outfit icon, Season Level, playlist mode, and Lang!ley Squad detection to Fortnite RPC.
